Title: Kunal's Day

Cast

1. Kunal - 9 years, son
Look: yellow T-shirt, blue shorts
2. Riya - 9 years, daughter
Look: yellow frock, two plaits
3. Sonali - 35 years, mother
Look: pink kurta, a long plait
4. Isha - 10 years, friend
Look: pink T-shirt, ponytail
5. Tanay - 10 years, friend
Look: red T-shirt, jeans

Places

1. The park - green grass, swings, benches
2. The road - a paved road, trees along it
3. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The park - Day

[Kunal stands in the park. Riya, Sonali and Tanay stand near him.]

Kunal: "Today feels like a good day."

[Kunal does push-ups.]

Kunal: "Hey, look at that!"

[Kunal does yoga on a mat.]

Sonali: "Tanay, listen!"

[Riya skips rope.]

Riya: "Wow, how lovely!"

Scene 2: The road - Day

[Kunal stands by the road. Sonali and Isha stand near him.]

Kunal: "Let's begin."

[Kunal rides his bicycle down the road.]

Kunal: "One more time!"

[Kunal gets into the car.]

Isha: "That was fun!"

[Kunal gets on the bus.]

Kunal: "Yes, all right."

[Kunal gets off the school bus.]

Sonali: "Exactly right."

[Kunal hops into an auto-rickshaw.]

Kunal (happily): "Mom, look at this."

[Kunal pedals his bicycle hard up the road.]

Isha: "That's great!"

Scene 3: The courtyard - Day

[Kunal stands in the courtyard. Sonali and Riya stand near him.]

Riya: "Let's begin."

[Kunal draws a picture of the house.]

Sonali: "Let's see."

[Kunal slips and falls.]

Riya: "This is amazing!"

[Suddenly it begins to pour.]

Kunal: "That was such a fun day!"
